BackstoryDef.title: salvage yard youth
BackstoryDef.description: Growing up under the shadow of a bitter, abusive father, [PAWN_nameDef] found refuge among rusted engines and heaps of scrap metal. [PAWN_pronoun] learned early how to coax life out of broken machines and keep [PAWN_possessive] head down when trouble came knocking.

BackstoryDef.title: junkyard lorekeeper
BackstoryDef.description: After a personal tragedy opened [PAWN_possessive] eyes to the supernatural, [PAWN_nameDef] turned [PAWN_possessive] salvage yard into a fortress and library of occult knowledge. Gruff and endlessly resourceful, [PAWN_pronoun] acts as dispatcher, mechanic, and surrogate father to younger hunters.

BackstoryDef.title: hardscrabble frontier kid
BackstoryDef.description: Raised in a settlement constantly threatened by raiders and wasteland beasts, [PAWN_nameDef] learned to haul timber, reinforce barricades, and handle heavy rifles before [PAWN_pronoun] was fully grown. Complaining never fixed a broken wall, a lesson [PAWN_pronoun] took to heart.

BackstoryDef.title: castle artillery veteran
BackstoryDef.description: As a former commander at the Castle, [PAWN_nameDef] drilled recruits in fortification design and long-range artillery fire until the militia fractured from within. Blunt, unsentimental, and fiercely disciplined, [PAWN_pronoun] refuses to let hard-won defenses fall into disrepair.

BackstoryDef.title: skeptical loner
BackstoryDef.description: Even as a youth, [PAWN_nameDef] trusted no one at face value and preferred taking clocks and locks apart to playing with other children. [PAWN_pronoun] developed a sharp eye for hidden mechanisms and a habit of planning three escape routes from every room.

BackstoryDef.title: grumpy trap specialist
BackstoryDef.description: A former intelligence operative turned seasoned monster hunter, [PAWN_nameDef] prefers working alone behind layers of tripwires, wards, and deadbolts. Though constantly complaining about noise and company, [PAWN_pronoun] reluctantly steps in when old allies are in over their heads.

BackstoryDef.title: backroad diner helper
BackstoryDef.description: Growing up helping run a busy roadside stop, [PAWN_nameDef] learned how to read strangers at a glance, pour stiff drinks, and keep rowdy patrons in line. [PAWN_pronoun] balanced warm hospitality with a no-nonsense temper that few dared to test twice.

BackstoryDef.title: roadhouse matriarch
BackstoryDef.description: Proprietor of the Roadhouse and widow of a fallen hunter, [PAWN_nameDef] keeps a loaded shotgun behind the bar and a watchful eye on her daughter. Wise, protective, and deadly accurate at close range, [PAWN_pronoun] serves as a steady anchor for hunters passing through.
